Syslog



Help


The device can send its log messages to a syslog server on the home network.

Syslog: Turns sending log messages to the syslog server on or off.

Server IP Address: The address of the syslog server.

Server Port: The UDP port of the syslog server, usually 514.

Log Level: Messages of this severity and more severe ones are sent.
